True evolution demands a cruel honesty: you cannot become a masterpiece while trying to keep everyone else comfortable. Break your ego into raw pieces, devour the talent around you, and rebuild yourself in the dark. In a world content with passing the ball, only the absolute egoist dares to take the shot.
